description: This file defines a utility object SplitUtils that provides a method to split a string into tokens based on spaces, returning a linked list of valid tokens.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: A utility object for splitting strings into tokens based on spaces

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens separated by spaces, returning a LinkedList of valid tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds the token to the list if it is valid (non-empty).

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if the token is valid, which currently means it is not empty.
